name: Move Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Data to Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Redshift data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **SFCC** account using the **(+)** icon with your **Client ID, Client Secret, Organization ID, Short Code** & **Site Id.** Read more about how to find these details [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/salesforce-cc/setup.html).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/salesforce-commerce-cloud/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
